description: Establish or update the active operational safety mandate for this agent session. Declares permissible boundaries, allowed tools, filesystem directories, write permissions, and risk tolerance. Loosening restrictions requires operatorSecret.

allowDestructive.description: Authorize destructive commands like file deletions or schema changes (default: false).

allowNetwork.description: Authorize outbound network connectivity and external API calls (default: false).

allowSubshells.description: Authorize nested subshell execution ($() or backticks) (default: false).

allowWrite.description: Authorize filesystem modifications or database write operations (default: false).

allowedPaths.description: Permitted filesystem root directories. Operations outside these paths will be flagged.

allowedTools.description: Whitelisted tool names. Use ['*'] to allow all non-disallowed tools.

operatorSecret.description: Operator authentication token required to loosen permissions on a locked mandate.

riskTolerance.description: Threshold policy: 'low' blocks any potential drift; 'high' permits warnings for non-critical risks.

taskDescription.description: Concise summary of the current user-authorized task/objective.

name: aletheia_set_mandate
